title: T2DM with diabetic CKD stage 3
encounterNote: 64-year-old female with type 2 diabetes mellitus and diabetic chronic kidney disease, stage 3, presents for routine follow-up. She reports no polyuria, polydipsia, or edema. Current medications: metformin 500 mg twice daily, empagliflozin 10 mg daily, and lisinopril 10 mg daily. Blood pressure is 132/78. Laboratory results today: eGFR in the stage 3 range and urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio 85 mg/g. Assessment: type 2 diabetes mellitus with diabetic chronic kidney disease, stage 3; blood pressure at goal. Continue current medications and repeat labs in three months.
